name: @langwatch/identity-server
description: The server-side runtime of the identity platform (ADR-101, ADR-115): IdentityGuards, IdentityService, the verification ceremony, the backfill pass, the better-auth ceremonies and the storage ports they run on. Storage-engine-free and better-auth-free - the app implements the repository interfaces with Prisma, binds the ceremonies to better-auth's databaseHooks, and implements the ledger port over its event-sourcing pipeline.
